sections.heading: 1. Choose Your Mode
sections.content: From the home page, pick either Market Impact (event → sector/company scores) or Company Impact (company + event → Defend/Capitalize plan).

sections.heading: 2. Enter an Event
sections.content: Paste a news headline, article text, or describe an event in your own words. Be specific: include magnitude, geography, and numbers where possible.

sections.heading: 3. Select Depth
sections.content: Quick (~2 min, 15 companies) • Standard (~6 min, 50 companies) • Deep (~12 min, 100+ companies)

sections.heading: 4. Confirm & Run
sections.content: Review the parsed event, edit if needed, then hit Run Analysis. Watch the simulated pipeline with live gateway feed.

sections.heading: 5. Read the Report
sections.content: Reports include executive summary, sector heatmap, company buckets (5 tiers), scenarios, timeline, and more. Company reports add dimension analysis, resilience radar, and a 3-column Defend/Capitalize plan.

how_to_write_event.title: How to Write a Good Event
good_examples: Crude oil spikes to $110 after OPEC+ announces 2M bpd supply cut extension through Q1 2027. Brent futures jump 15% in a week. India imports 85% of crude.
US imposes 25% tariff on Indian textiles ($8B), auto parts ($2B), gems & jewellery ($2B). Effective immediately. India retaliates with tariffs on US almonds, apples.
RBI MPC cuts repo rate by 25 bps to 6.25%; stance changes to 'accommodative'. CPI at 4.2%. GDP forecast 7.0%. First cut since Apr 2023.
tips: Mention the source or trigger (OPEC+, RBI, US govt)
State the duration if known (temporary vs structural)
Mention any policy responses already announced

how_to_read_market_report.title: How to Read the Market Impact Report

sections.heading: Executive Summary + Verdict Box
sections.content: One-paragraph takeaway + market tone arrow, bucket counts, confidence. Start here.

sections.heading: Event & Channels
sections.content: What the engine understood. Channels show transmission paths with strength (1-5) and direction.

sections.heading: Macro Impact Table
sections.content: GDP, CPI, CAD, INR, yields, RBI stance, FII flows, index tone — each with direction, magnitude, confidence, horizon.

sections.heading: Sector Heatmap
sections.content: 25 sectors scored -5 to +5. Hover for reasoning. Click to filter company tables.

sections.heading: Company Buckets (5 tiers)
sections.content: ■ High Danger ≤ -3.5 | ■ Moderate Negative -3.5 to -1.5 | ■ Little/No Effect -1.5 to +1.5 | ■ Moderate Positive +1.5 to +3.5 | ■ Massive Gain ≥ +3.5. Click a row for full reasoning drawer.

sections.heading: Uncertain List
sections.content: Companies where confidence is low — read the data gaps.

sections.heading: Scenarios
sections.content: Best / Base / Worst with narrative, triggers, and which companies shift buckets.

sections.heading: Timeline & Watchlist
sections.content: Day 1 → Quarter 1 expected developments + specific triggers to monitor.

how_to_read_company_report.title: How to Read the Company Impact Report

sections.heading: At-a-Glance Box
sections.content: Net impact score (-3 to +3), resilience band, stance (Defend/Capitalize/Both), confidence.

sections.heading: Impact by Dimension (13 rows)
sections.content: Each dimension scored -3 to +3 with expandable explanation, evidence, magnitude, timing, confidence. Dimensions: Revenue, Pricing, Input Costs, Margins, Working Capital, Debt & Interest, Forex, Supply Chain, Demand, Regulatory, Reputation, Capex, Governance.

sections.heading: Financial Resilience
sections.content: Score 0-100, band (High/Med/Low), strengths/weaknesses, key ratios (Debt/Equity, Current Ratio, Interest Coverage, FCF Yield, ROE, ROCE), radar chart.

sections.heading: Market View
sections.content: Technical bias (1D/1W/1M), priced-in check, 10 news headlines with sentiment + materiality chips.

sections.heading: Peer Comparison
sections.content: 4-5 peers with impact scores, buckets, and better/worse vs subject.

sections.heading: Strategic Plan — Defend | Capitalize
sections.content: Two tabs, each with three time columns: Immediate (0-30d), Short (1-6m), Long (6-24m). Action cards: action, lever, why, owner, effort, expected effect, risk. Checkbox to mark 'considered'.

sections.heading: KPIs & Triggers
sections.content: Specific metrics to track + 'if X then switch plan to Y' rules.

sections.heading: Plan Scenarios
sections.content: How the Defend/Capitalize plan performs under Best/Base/Worst event scenarios.

key_rotation.title: Key Rotation Explained
key_rotation.content: The real product uses multiple free-tier API keys (Google Gemini) with daily call caps. The gateway rotates keys automatically: when one hits rate limit (429), it cools down (60s) and switches to the next key. If all keys exhaust, the run pauses with a 'Resume Later' screen — partial results are saved. In the mock, the Gateway Feed simulates this with scripted events.

questions.a: No. This is a frontend-only mock. All data is pre-written sample content. The demo banner on every page reminds you of this.

Yes, but the mock maps your text to the closest of 3 sample scenarios (crude spike, US tariffs, RBI rate cut) using keyword matching. Unknown text falls back to a generic scenario with a visible notice.
Low confidence means the engine lacks enough data (e.g., complex conglomerate, governance overhang, missing segments). The real version would flag these for human review.

questions.q: What do the bucket thresholds mean?
questions.a: Impact score -5 to +5 maps to 5 buckets: ≤-3.5 Danger, -3.5 to -1.5 Negative, -1.5 to +1.5 Neutral, +1.5 to +3.5 Positive, ≥+3.5 Gain. Score is a weighted composite of channels, resilience, and macro.
In the mock, 'Save' writes to localStorage only. The Reports History page shows pre-seeded mock reports plus any you save during the session.

questions.q: How does Mode B differ from Mode A?
questions.a: Mode A: event → entire market. Mode B: company + event → company-specific impact across 13 dimensions + a Defend/Capitalize action plan with owners, timelines, and KPIs.

For companies without a hand-written Mode B scenario, the engine builds a plausible report from the company's exposure tags using a rule table. This ensures every company in the ~50 universe can produce some output.

High/Medium/Low based on financial ratios, leverage, liquidity, profitability, and business model stability.
Strategic stance: Defend = protect value; Capitalize = seize opportunity; Both = mixed.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.content: This is a demonstration prototype (mock UI) for the India Event-Impact Intelligence Tool. All data, scores, reasoning, company assessments, strategic plans, and numbers shown are fictional/sample content created solely to illustrate the product concept. They must not be used for investment decisions, trading, or any real-world financial purpose. The real product (when built) will have its own methodology, data sources, back-testing, and disclaimers. Past performance of sample scenarios does not predict future results. Consult a SEBI-registered investment advisor before making any financial decisions.
